about:
# MiniReload

A minimap button that reloads your UI. One click, no typing.

Handy when a controller or bar addon breaks and you can't reach `/reload`:
the button sits on the minimap, independent of your action bars.

## Usage

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Left-click the minimap button | Reload the UI |
| Hover over the minimap button | See when you last reloaded (or logged in), e.g. `Reloaded 12 min ago (14:32)` |
| Drag the minimap button | Move it around the minimap edge |
| `/rl` or `/minireload` | Reload the UI |
| `/minireload hide` / `/minireload show` | Hide or show the minimap button |

If another addon also registers `/rl`, whichever loads last owns it. Both
reload, so it doesn't matter.

## Supported versions

Retail, Classic Era, TBC Anniversary, and WoW: Forever.

## Install

Download `MiniReload-<version>.zip` from the
[Releases](https://github.com/nym1k/MiniReload/releases) page and extract it
into `World of Warcraft/<version>/Interface/AddOns/`, so you end up with
`Interface/AddOns/MiniReload/MiniReload.toc`. The release zip includes the
libraries it needs.

Installing from a clone of this repo instead? The libraries aren't
committed, so you'd need to fetch them yourself (see `.pkgmeta`).

## Libraries

Uses [LibDataBroker-1.1](https://github.com/tekkub/libdatabroker-1-1) and
[LibDBIcon-1.0](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libdbicon-1-0) (with
LibStub and CallbackHandler-1.0), the standard minimap button libraries, so
minimap button collectors and minimap skins handle it like any other addon
icon.

## License

MIT, see [LICENSE](https://github.com/nym1k/MiniReload/blob/main/LICENSE). The bundled libraries keep their own licenses.

releases.name: MiniReload 1.0.0
releases.notes:
First release.

- Minimap button: click to reload your UI, drag to move it around the minimap.
- Hover to see when you last reloaded (or logged in).
- Adds `/rl` (and `/minireload`) to reload from chat. `/minireload hide` / `/minireload show` toggles the icon.
- Supports Retail, Classic Era, TBC Anniversary and WoW: Forever.

**Install:** download `MiniReload-1.0.0.zip` below and extract it into `World of Warcraft/<version>/Interface/AddOns/`. The zip includes the libraries it needs.
